draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and seed spread (exp1/cmp2). No noise-perturbation experiments, no T2 table, and no F1-drop values (0.6, 1.3, 1.8) appear anywhere. The cited evidence IDs (T2.r1–r3.th_drop) do not exist in the package. The claim is entirely unsupported.
